equip_menu.doc: The equip page (M2-MNU-02; docs/kb/tech/ui.md section 'Equip and Customize pages'). Rects are x, y, w, h at the 1920 x 1080 reference, multiples of 3. 'heroes' (left), 'gear' (the hero's slots and ability slots, middle) and 'choice' (the pieces for a slot, or the Customize recipes, in the gear page's place) are MenuPage metrics blocks, each as tall as its rows up to max_rows. 'portrait' (M2-MNU-301) is the shown hero's portrait (HeroPortraitFrame) right of the heroes page. 'desc' is the line about the highlighted row under the heroes page, with the status line (a refusal in the danger color) 'status' gap under it. 'preview' (right) holds a header, the stat table ('stat_pitch' per row; 'cols' are x offsets and widths inside it: name, now, arrow, next, delta) and, 'changes_gap' under it, the abilities gained and lost or the recipe, down to 'changes_pad' above the panel's foot (clipped there). M2-MNU-05: the stat rows' pitch grows to the font's line height at a large text size, and the stat name ellipsizes in its column.
